name: Laban
bio:
Laban is the son of Bethuel and Rebekah's brother, first appearing in Genesis 24, warmly welcoming Abraham's servant who had come to seek a wife for Isaac and agreeing to let his sister Rebekah marry him far from home. His story develops much further after Jacob flees to him for refuge — Laban has Jacob shepherd his flocks for years while repeatedly changing his wages, and on Jacob's wedding night substitutes Leah for Rachel, tricking Jacob into marrying both sisters (Genesis 29).

Though Laban dealt shrewdly and calculatingly with Jacob, Jacob nevertheless grew prosperous through God's blessing; the property dispute between the two men ultimately ended with them setting up a stone pillar as a witness at Gilead and making a covenant before going their separate ways (Genesis 31). Laban's story is often set alongside the deceptions Jacob himself used earlier against his brother Esau and father Isaac, showing that under Laban's hand Jacob experienced much the same kind of treatment he had once dealt out to others.
